claims.text: In a separate email of 6 March 2015 Fish relays a claim that Project Blue Book continued after 1970, concluding 'if true, Blue Book was not disbanded - only the outer layer of the onion (the "public information layer) was stripped away in 1970.'

title: WikiLeaks, The Podesta Emails, email id 31721
